$comment: High and critical advisories that have been reviewed and accepted, read by
.github/scripts/dependency-audit.mjs on every push and pull request (#335).
An entry is not a way to silence a finding: it is a note that this advisory
cannot be reached from the app, or that its fix needs a change that belongs
in its own pull request. Anything not listed here fails the audit job, so a
new advisory is visible on the pull request that adds it.
Every entry needs `package`, `reason` and `reviewBy` (YYYY-MM-DD). When the
date passes the job still passes but warns, so the exception gets looked at
again rather than living here forever. Remove an entry as soon as the
advisory disappears from `npm audit --omit=dev`; the job warns about those

exceptions.reason: The only fix npm offers is a semver-major change of the wallet kit itself (2.8.0 -> 1.9.5), which owns the signing path. That upgrade is its own change, needing manual wallet testing, not a lockfile bump inside the audit job.

Transitive under @coinbase/cdp-sdk inside the wallet kit's WalletConnect option. The app's own HTTP goes through fetch, not axios, and the advisories are prototype-pollution and proxy-bypass gadgets in request construction; no app code constructs axios requests or sets a proxy. Fixed by the wallet-kit upgrade above.

Two copies, pinned inside @reown/appkit-wallet (3.22.4) and @coinbase/cdp-sdk. The advisory is memory exhaustion validating an oversized constrained collection; those schemas validate WalletConnect's own payloads, not user input, and the wallet kit pins the version. Fixed by the wallet-kit upgrade above.
ABI type generation inside @coinbase/cdp-sdk. It is a build-time-shaped dependency of that SDK; nothing passes it untrusted ABI data at run time. Fixed by the wallet-kit upgrade above.

The Coinbase mobile-wallet path inside the wallet kit's WalletConnect option, which is only loaded when NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID is set (see src/lib/walletconnect.ts). It pulls axios, zod and abitype, so it inherits their entries. Fixed by the wallet-kit upgrade above.

Reown AppKit is reached only through @creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit's WalletConnect option, and only in builds that set NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID. It stays out of the initial bundle otherwise (see the bundle-size check). Fixed by the wallet-kit upgrade above.
